_comment: Two group kinds exist. MERGE: one canonical enchantment absorbs the removed members — it's broadened to their item types, level-capped per item, and inherits their vanilla conflicts. SUPPRESS: multiple keepers coexist, each on its own item types; removed members on an item get rewritten to whichever keeper accepts it (or stripped if none do). Optional 'description' text shows in item tooltips; use 'keeperDescriptions' to override per-keeper for SUPPRESS groups. Keys starting with _ are examples for reference and are ignored by the loader.

_example_merge.description: Extended: also applies to swords (looting) and fishing rods (luck).

groups.description: Applies as Looting on swords and Luck of the Sea on fishing rods.
Applies as Fire Aspect on melee weapons — attacks set targets on fire.
Applies as Punch on bows — arrows knock targets back farther.
Applies as Sharpness on melee weapons and Impaling on tridents.
Applies as Lure on fishing rods — shortens wait time between bites.
